Rishi / Stephanie / Sara —

Draft runbook attached (dedicated-migration-runbook-20260522.md). High level plan below — condensed. I've kept the window to Sat 00:00–04:00 PT as requested.

Planned cutover (proposed):
- Week 0: Contract signed + provisioning request (we provision new pool POOL-NIM-2: 8x A100).
- Week 2: Provisioning complete and smoke tests by Redwood SE.
- Week 3 (Weekend night): Begin canary stages:
  * Step A (T+0): Route 10% traffic to POOL-NIM-2. Monitor 2 hours.
  * Step B (T+2h): If stable (P95 latency delta < 15% and error rate < 0.5%), raise to 25%. Monitor 4 hours.
  * Step C (T+6h): If stable, raise to 50%. Monitor 8 hours.
  * Step D (T+14h): Raise to 100% and deprecate old pool for critical routes, keep old pool in warm standby for 48 hours.

Monitoring & success criteria (canary):
- Latency: P95 for /v1/predict/hipaa on new pool must be within +15% of baseline or absolute < 450ms (whichever stricter).
- Errors: 5xx error rate < 0.5% for any 15 min window.
- Throughput: Sustained 500 reqs/min across the pool for 30 minutes without queuing.

Rollback criteria:
- Any 15m window with errors >1% OR P95 increase >30% -> immediate rollback to prior routing and page SE + Infra.
- If GPU OOMs or queue depth grows beyond threshold, rollback and open incident.

On-call: Stephanie will be primary SE (stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com), Laura will coordinate CS and account comms. Rishi to manage contract & procurement updates.

Attachments: [attachment: dedicated-migration-runbook-20260522.md (text/markdown)]

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
